title: What a piece of crap!
text: What a piece of crap!. This is a huge waste of money. It was not the easiest thing to put together. I’ve owned it for maybe a month now and it’s falling apart. I’d have to take all the shoes out and basically rebuild the whole thing at this point. As soon as I find something else this is going on the trash!
